recipe.variant: SDXL 1.0 base + xinsir ControlNet++ ProMax union (one 2.5 GB net for openpose / depth / hed-pidi-scribble-ted / canny-lineart-anime_lineart-mlsd / normal / segment / tile / repaint) with SetUnionControlNetType; native Canny shown
recipe.from_template: NONE - no Comfy-Org template exists (NOT FOUND). COMMUNITY-CONFIRMED assembly: SetUnionControlNetType -> ControlNetApplyAdvanced chain from the ComfyUI_examples controlnet page and comfy_extras/nodes_controlnet.py, xinsir README (strength 1.0, type list), host spine from the sdxl_simple_example template (base model only, 25 steps, cfg 8, euler/normal, 1024x1024, negative 'text, watermark').

anchor.splice: SetUnionControlNetType (35) MUST sit between the loader and the apply node with an explicit type (auto skips the task embedding); ControlNetApplyAdvanced (33) between positive/negative and KSampler (no vae: SDXL hints are pixel-space). Several conditions = chain more apply nodes, each with its own SetUnionControlNetType copy. The map must match the latent (9) size.

sampler.note: the sampling method (ComfyUI's sampler list: euler, dpmpp_2m, res_multistep, …)

scheduler.note: the noise schedule (simple, normal, karras, beta, sgm_uniform, …)

control_image.note: raw photo for the canny type (native Canny at the node defaults 0.4/0.8 - no publisher thresholds exist for SDXL). For openpose/depth/hed/... replace node 31 with the matching comfyui_controlnet_aux node (OpenposePreprocessor with scale_stick_for_xinsr_cn=enable for this net) and set union_type accordingly.

recipe.defaults_note: 1024x1024 (SDXL trained sizes: 1024x1024, 1152x896, 896x1152, 1216x832, 832x1216, 1344x768, 768x1344, 1536x640, 640x1536), 25 steps, cfg 8, euler/normal, strength 1.0 (xinsir: 'Default setting is 1.0 for each condition input'). tile/repaint types need THIS ProMax file; the plain union file raises 'Control type ... is out of range'. The HF filename is generic - keep the promax name or rename, but then update files[].
